prompt.zh-TW: 星橋物流今年營業收入 {{money:vars.revenue}}，年底資產總計 {{money:vars.assets}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算總資產週轉率，以「次」作答。
prompt.en: Starbridge Logistics had revenue of {{money:vars.revenue}} this year and total assets of {{money:vars.assets}} at year end. Using the course Excel basis, what is the total asset turnover? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_2cqt9cfd}}＝{{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}，回答「每一元資產一年做出多少營收」。它也是杜邦拆解裡的一個因子，數字越大表示資產用得越勤。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_2cqt9cfd}} = {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}: how much revenue each dollar of assets generates in a year. It is also one factor in the DuPont breakdown; the higher it is, the harder the assets are working.
